review_requirements: reject missing or stale summary heartbeat
reject completion unless every TOML Error Contract Gate row is satisfied or source-proven non-applicable
reject public tests pass as a substitute for exact contract evidence
reject AC does not require exact messages as a substitute for the schema gate
reject custom parser probes as sole evidence for fixture parity, exact errors, constructor behavior, invalid date wrapping, or parse_float invalid return behavior
require upstream-compatible invalid fixtures rejected with TOMLDecodeError
require exact TOMLDecodeError message, line, column, missing-value, and invalid-character quote evidence
require TOMLDecodeError no-arg and 3-arg constructor behavior plus module evidence
require invalid date wrapping and invalid parse_float return ValueError evidence
